headline: Golf-Fueled Revenue Beat Might Change The Case For Investing In VICI Properties (VICI)
summary: In the June 2026 quarter, VICI Properties Inc. reported US$1.06 billion in revenue, topping Wall Street estimates while matching consensus EPS of US$0.62 and FFO expectations. An interesting angle is that growth in golf-related revenues and other experiential segments underpinned this revenue beat, highlighting momentum beyond VICI’s core casino properties.
